notes.title: Update 1.4.7 - Map editor props
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
Fixed a bug which caused thumbnails in the map editor to not work. 

Added another attempt to reduce crashing when starting custom maps…

Changes
Added props to the map editor!

Fine-tuned the ground physics. The disc should feel slightly less slidey when interacting with the ground. Feedback on this is appreciated : )

Made the glimmer effect more visible on the high-end disc materials.


Map editor props
Finally the props menu is available in the map editor. Populate your maps with obstacles and decoration!



Right now there are 11 props, which should be enough to make some interesting maps. But i am really excited to add more props in coming updates. Tell me what you want to see. 


You can adjust the size and rotation of all props, and there are no limits to the size. You can go crazy with it if you want. Right now its not possible to place teepads or baskets on top of props, and you are limited to placing props on the ground surface. However i would like to lift these restrictions in a future update. 

Known bugs
I am in the process of fixing these bugs, but i really wanted to post this update as soon as possible, so these will have to wait for a few weeks. Sorry!


Starting an online game while some players are still downloading a custom map leads to a crash. In the meantime, wait a little extra before starting.

Creating very large OB zones on custom maps lead to a freeze when trying to load the map.

notes.title: Update 1.4.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here is a small update which adds some quality of life features. 



Most notably, an ancient bug has been fixed, which made the ground physics different for different players in the same game. This makes it possible to host tournaments again. I will start planning.



I also recently noticed that the leaderboards don't work, and that they likely have been broken for a long time. Now they work again.



Changes

The random map seed is now randomized in the lobby. This will make you play an unique map every round if you don't touch the seed setting. 

Improved save file handling.

Added file corruption checks: the game can no longer overwrite your old save file if it thinks the new save file is corrupt. 

The game now automatically saves backups. They can be found in the following folder: C:\\Users\\\[YOUR NAME]\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Bear Feet Games\\Disc Golf Online\\saveBackups

Bugfixes

Fixed a bug which caused ground physics to be different between the host and other players.

Fixed a bug which made very large OB zones invisible on custom maps.

Fixed a “bug” which caused the leaderboards to update improperly.

notes.title: Update 1.4.5
notes.notes:
I have gotten feedback that the game can be frustrating, so I decided to add some features to help with that. One thing that many people found annoying is walking to get your disc after throwing it far into the ocean, or after forgetting it in the previous basket. I kind of like the “real” aspect of that, but I totally see that it’s a source of frustration. So no more of that, you can now always pick up your disc with E (standard keybind) regardless of where it is. Teleporting now also puts the disc straight into your hand. Less button presses and less confusion. 

Aside from that there are some UI changes that aim to make the screen less cluttered. 

Changes
Moved the “in throw zone” indicator away from the middle of the screen. 
Added basket distance to the throwing UI. 
Made the disc position indicator invisible when following the disc during a throw. 
Significantly increased performance on custom maps with many OB zones.
Attempting to pick up a disc now automatically equips the last thrown disc regardless of distance.
Added automatic disc pickup when teleporting. 

Bugfixes
Fixed a bug which caused “downloading map” to appear in random map lobbies.

notes.title: Update 1.4.3 - Map editor OB zones
notes.notes:
Map editor OB zones
You can now create OB-zones in the map editor! Freely draw OB areas straight onto the terrain wherever you want. You can also add drop zones to make those impossible OB zones a bit more forgiving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42651392/83c6ef6daaae9892aeac49c1fe8cbf825c72a8a0.png
Changes

Significantly decreased loading time of the custom map browser - “Quick load”

All maps created after this update will have the Quick load feature. This makes them load into the custom map browser around 5000 times faster. 
The first time you load a non-Quick load map, the game will add Quick load to it. This takes some time, so the first time you open the custom map browser it will be slower than usual. It will also be slower after downloading a non-Quick load map. 
Re-save your maps and re-upload them to the steam workshop to add Quick load to them. 
Maps will load into the play mode at the same speed as before. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42651392/c2972bdc11db649cdc5f6834cda195c204a9061d.png
20 maps without Quick load - ~30 seconds. 
With Quick load - blink and you will miss it. 

Added a warning to the map editor when you add too many trees. 
Increased quality of main menu icons.
Added the ability to create OB-zones and place drop zone tees in the map editor. 

OB does not work when test-playing a map in the map editor.
Drop zones only work when you start out of bounds, for example on an island hole. 


Bugfixes
Fixed a bug which sometimes caused the daily and weekly challenge to load a custom map instead of the challenge map. 
Fixed a bug in the map editor which caused terrain to keep getting placed when holding click and moving the mouse out of the game window. 
Fixed a bug which caused different basket types to be spawned than shown in the map editor. 
Fixed a bug which sometimes caused the game to start at the wrong resolution.
Fixed a bug which caused the resolution selection arrows to sometimes require more than one click to change resolution. 
Fixed a bug which caused the tournament winners crown to be invisible. 
Fixed a bug which caused ugly clipping on near vertical terrain surfaces.

notes.title: Update 1.4 The Map Editor
notes.notes:
The map editor
This update makes the long awaited map editor available to all players. It lets you create your own courses, and upload them to the steam workshop. You can play custom maps both online and offline, where your own maps are available in offline mode, and downloaded maps in online mode. 

Currently, you can

Create custom terrain


 Sculpt the world to your liking using simple but effective tools. Create terrain completely from scratch, or modify randomly generated terrain.

Create forests and individual trees

 Populate your course with trees. 
 Create open fields for easy courses, or create an impossible hole with 1000 trees in the way. The map editor lets you do things the random map generator can’t do. 

Place baskets and tees

 You can set the par for individual holes, and change the number of holes. 

Test play as you go

 Spawn your character straight into the course while creating. 

Publish your courses

 Published courses appear in the steam workshop for all players. 
 If you don’t want to create your own courses, you can always download and play someone else's course. 

Notably, a few features from the random map generator are missing, such as lakes and OB zones. Because of this, I have decided to launch the map editor as a “beta” version. It works, and is capable of creating fun maps, but it is not completely finished and may contain bugs. 

In the future, I want to add these, and more features that are not available in the random map generator. For example, mandatories are difficult to randomly generate, but would be possible to create in the map editor. I also want to add more props that you can place, and possibly allow players to import their own 3D models into the map. Please leave feedback on what you would like to see added. 

Oh, and before you try it. You cannot make a course with 18 point blank baskets and farm aces for the leaderboard. Stats in custom maps do not post to the leaderboard. Sorry!

Here are all the other changes and bugfixes:

Changes
Added unique items that can only be received from winning tournaments. 
Added start time option in the lobby.
Added the map editor.

Bugfixes
Fixed a bug where OB bollards didn’t spawn in rare cases.
Fixed a bug which under (very) specific circumstances prevented players from interacting with discs or the backpack.
Fixed a bug which caused the player to end up outside the throwzone when teleporting. 
Fixed a bug which caused the teleport ability to fail randomly.
Fixed a bug which caused the weekly challenge leaderboards to break when the month changes in the middle of a week (I could have predicted this would happen).
Fixed a bug which caused the leaderboards to have unnecessarily large gaps between players. 
Fixed a bug which caused the weekly and daily challenge leaderboards to sometimes have incorrectly displayed scores.
Fixed a bug which prevented increase/decrease power from being bound to other keys than the scroll wheel. 
Fixed a bug which sometimes caused the throw zone to be incorrectly placed when a disc goes out of bounds. 
Fixed a bug which caused the pinky finger to get spasms when holding the disc at certain angles.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update finally fixes most of the game's annoying networking quirks. Hopefully this will make the game more enjoyable to play overall. A bunch of other smaller bugs have also been fixed, and some features have been added.

Most notably, a new attempt at better disc physics has been implemented. This is aimed at improving the interactions between the disc and the ground, which has been somewhat unrealistic for a long time. Specifically, it makes the disc calm down faster after landing. As always: please leave feedback on the disc physics. I consider it the biggest advantage of this game compared to other disc golf games, and I want it to be perfect! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42651392/978bfc622090b1e81f51a3ae81612483e75f96ea.gif

Networking bug fixes
Fixed a bug which sometimes (almost always) stopped stats and challenge results from being uploaded by non-hosts when playing in a group.
Fixed a bug which stopped players from exiting new lobbies after leaving or finishing a game. 
Fixed a bug in multiplayer mode which sometimes caused players to spawn on different maps. 

Other bug fixes

Fixed a bug which caused strange UI interactions when selling equipment.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - The Challenges and Community Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! After a small break from development, I have a new update that I'm very excited for. Update 1.3 brings the Community menu to the game! Through this menu you can play daily and weekly challenges, and view the leaderboards which display the top players in some categories. I hope that this update will bring an increased sense of online presence, and add some competitive elements to the game

Improved disc physics
I have been very fond of keeping the disc physics 100% realistic. This means all the physics code comes straight from physics equations. However, there has always been one aspect that I have not been able to accurately capture with equations only: friction. With low friction values, the disc skips like it should and generally behaves well at high speed, but if the disc lands on a hill it starts sliding which is very annoying. With high friction values the disc does not slide down hills but behaves very weird when it touches the ground at high speed. This gave me an idea that seems to fix both problems: artificially increase the disc friction at low speeds. A nice side effect of this is that the disc can jump around a little when stopping, as if there were imperfections or small rocks in the ground. Let me know in the discord channel if you notice any weird physics that may come from this change.

Changes:
Made discs less likely to slide down steep surfaces after landing.
Made the saved seeds window less confusing.
Discs will now stay in the same spot in backpacks between games.
OB zones can now only reset players to a dropzone on the first throw.

The community menu
Added the community menu
Features:
The daily & weekly challenges
Here you can play a special seed that updates every week or day. The seed is the same for everyone, and your score on the round is uploaded to a server. The top 5 scores on each challenge are displayed for everyone. Once you complete a challenge, you can’t play it again until the challenge resets. 

The daily challenge is a short 9 hole round, and resets each day at 10 am UTC.
The weekly challenge is a longer 18 hole round that resets each Friday at 10 am UTC.

Leaderboards 
Here you can view the top players in (for now) four categories:

 Best score - total score over par for any round.
 Number of aces - just in case it ever happens.
 Longest throw - longest distance of any throw.
 Longest putt - longest distance of any throw that ends up in the basket.

	Through this menu you can also view other players' steam profiles.

To celebrate this, and to bring some new players to compete against, the game will be on a 50% sale for one week.

notes.title: Update 1.2.7 Mountains!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Mountains are back in Disc Golf Online! Continuing on the terrain improvements in patch 1.2.6, the mountain biome has been (re)added to the game, as well as some improvements to terrain generation around lakes, baskets, and tees. 

Also worth to note is that Disc Golf Online is on sale right now, as part of the steam winter sale. 

Mountains
When mountains were removed from the game back in update 1.1, any map with a lake had the possibility to generate an essentially vertical wall around the lake (to stop water from running away). Mountains also had the tendency to generate courses that required you to throw 300 m / 1000 ft uphill. This was deemed game-breaking and mountains were removed. Mountains in this patch are not as extremely high as they were in update 1.0, but they will still be over 100 m / 330 ft high on some maps, which will make for some interesting, but not impossible holes. 

In patch 1.2.7 these vertical walls can no longer be generated around lakes, instead there will be a smooth hill leading up to the water. The smoothing has also been applied around tees and baskets. This makes the disc more likely to stay around the basket if you throw a perfect approach. 

One-off discs
I have also worked on the disc artwork system to make it easier to add special artworks for discs in the future. This patch includes 4 new “one-off” discs with a common theme. These one-off discs have special artworks, but are based on an already existing disc mold. They unlock at level 20 and are more expensive than normal discs. 

All changes
Added mountains as a terrain option.
Added smoother terrain around lakes, baskets and tees.
Added new special artworks for several discs.

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug where some types of islands were incorrectly classified as out of bounds. 
Fixed a bug where discs could become stuck in the top part of baskets.

notes.title: Update 1.2.5 : The Disc Physics Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.5 is now live! 

This update brings some noticable changes to the disc physics, and some changes to the keybinds menu. 

These changes aim to improve how discs skip off the ground, and generally feel more realistic when interacting with terrain and obstacles. The turn and fade of all discs have also been adjusted, to make the discs behave like you would expect them to do in real life. This means the effects of fade has been reduced for almost all discs, while turn has increased for some discs and decreased for others. 



All changes
Improved how discs interact with the ground. 
Adjusted turn and fade for all discs. 
Added reset all keybinds button in the settings menu. 

All bug fixes
Fixed a bug where resetting keybinds while in a game sometimes had no effect.

notes.title: Update 1.2: The Improved Foliage Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Finally Update 1.2 is here, which brings some requested improvements to the foliage, a few quality of life features such as teleportation and selling items, and left handed throws.

Foliage
All disc golfers know trees are always in the way. In Disc Golf Online however, the trees were sometimes too much in the way, even obscuring the basket in some cases. With Update 1.2, this should no longer be the case. The minimum tree height has been greatly increased, and if a tree happens to spawn too close to a basket, it is now instantly removed. 

Bushes can also be very annoying, and you often get stuck in the middle of them. In Update 1.2, bushes slow less near the edges (like a real bush would), which allows you to more easily throw out of them. They are now also smaller, more spread out on courses, and no longer appear right in front of tees. 

New features
Finally left handed throwers can experience Disc Golf Online like they are used to in real life. You may set your character's preferred throwing hand in the character customization screen. 

Tired of walking to the disc every time you throw it? Me too! You can now press the “Teleport to throwzone” button after the disc has landed, the default key is “T” on keyboard and the B-button on xbox controllers. You can also choose to walk, it is up to you! 

It is now possible to sell your old discs or equipment. Press the sell button that has been added to each item in the inventory, to sell the item at half price. 

All changes
Added throw type indicator in the throw sequence.
Added option to teleport to valid throw zones.
Added left handed option in the character customization menu. 
Added option to sell items at half price. 
Decreased overall amount of bushes and bush size.
Greatly increased clear zone around baskets and tees where bushes cannot spawn. 
Increased minimum tree height.
Prevented baskets from spawning in trees. 
Significantly reduced slow at the edge of bushes. 
Improved bush visuals. 
Slightly increased money reward for completing rounds. 
Reduced price of pants. 
Minor UI tweaks. 

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug where Close Backpack always had the standard binding
Fixed a bug where the characters arm would bend in strange ways when holding the disc.
Fixed a bug where the characters torso sometimes remained twisted after a throw.
Fixed a bug where discs could collide with other players discs.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello!

This hotfix disables the map generator from generating mountains in courses. 

Mountain courses are meant to be a part of the game, but in their current state they have a severe negative impact on gameplay. Mountains will be re-added once the map generator has been improved to support them properly. 

Note that if you have any saved seeds, the maps generated by them may look different.

There are some holes which end on a small island in a lake or the ocean. These islands have been greatly increased in size to make it easier (possible) to land on them with your disc. 
 
All changes
-Disabled mountain generation
+Increased size of small islands with baskets on them

notes.title: Update 1.1 - The post-launch update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The first update for Disc Golf Online is now live. I am very happy to see some players enjoying the game right after launch, and there has been some valuable feedback so far. In this update a few bugs have been fixed and some features have been improved.

Disc Golf Online is better when you have people to play with, which is why the Official Discord server is now live. You can find a button with an invite link in the main menu, or join directly with this link: https://discord.gg/2YubyzYdEB

Here are all changes:

+Made the movement more responsive.
+Made the day/night cycle around 4 times longer.
+Made help markers easier to see from far away.
+Added reset to tee button in the pause menu. 
+Added Discord button. 

And all bugfixes:

-Fixed a bug where small islands would be considered out of bounds. 
-Fixed a bug where large parts of some generated maps would be underwater. 
-Fixed a bug where goals would sometimes not be detected. 
-Fixed a bug where picking up the disc quickly after scoring a goal would stop players from finishing the game. 
-Added some bugs (maybe). 

Demo version
+Same as above.
+Improved demo map. 
+Added tutorial from full game to demo.

-Fixed an issue where the game could crash while loading the map if you clicked too much.
